body.name: DeltaCmp
body.def: \(\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}(P)=E_P[(b^{\mathrm{cmp}})^{\prime}\Gamma_P(X)b^{\mathrm{cmp}}-b^{\star}(X)^{\prime}\Gamma_P(X)b^{\star}(X)]\), where \(\Omega_P=E_P[\Gamma_P(X)+Ah_P(X)h_P(X)^{\prime}A^{\prime}]\) determines \(b^{\mathrm{cmp}}\) through its declared Moore--Penrose KKT system.
